versions.title: The Staff Room

skins.name: Flame Professor — Emberfell House
skins.story: The oldest teacher of Emberfell lights the classroom candles with a snap of his fingers and keeps his half-moon spectacles on the tip of his nose.

skins.name: Storm Librarian — Stormleaf House
skins.story: The Stormleaf librarian pins her shawl with a silver lightning bolt and hushes every whisper in the great library before it reaches the shelves.

skins.name: Moon Astronomer — Moonvein House
skins.story: The Moonvein astronomer climbs the north tower every clear night, her brass monocle fixed on the stars stitched into her hood.

versions.note: The teachers step out of the staff room: an old fire professor with a beard down to his belt, the Stormleaf librarian who never lets a book go and the Moonvein astronomer who maps the night sky.

versions.title: Prefects and Champions

skins.name: Ember Duel Champion — Emberfell House
skins.story: The Emberfell duel champion has never lost a match in the great hall, and the gold medal on his sash still smells of smoke.

skins.name: Verdant Prefect — Verdanthold House
skins.story: The Verdanthold prefect polishes her bronze leaf badge every morning and knows every rule of the academy by heart, even the forgotten ones.

skins.name: Storm Windcaller — Stormleaf House
skins.story: The Stormleaf windcaller pulls down his flight goggles, whistles up a gust and lets his long scarf point the way across the rooftops.

versions.note: Three students earn their colours: the undefeated Emberfell duel champion, a Verdanthold prefect with a shiny new badge and a Stormleaf windcaller who rides the gusts over the towers.

versions.title: Grounds and Cellars

skins.name: Verdant Groundskeeper — Verdanthold House
skins.story: The Verdanthold groundskeeper talks to every tree on the academy grounds and always carries a trowel in his bib pocket, just in case one answers.

skins.name: Moon Alchemist — Moonvein House
skins.story: The Moonvein alchemist brews silver potions by moonlight in the cellar, and her wild hair has never fully recovered from the last explosion.

skins.name: Ember Hearth Cook — Emberfell House
skins.story: The Emberfell cook lights the great hearth with one breath every morning and serves a stew so hot that it glows in the bowl.

versions.note: Far from the classrooms the academy keeps on running: the groundskeeper of the herb gardens, the alchemist of the moonlit cellar and the cook who keeps the great hearth burning.
